background: Flat FLRW without radiation: E(z)^2 = Omega_m (1+z)^3 + (1-Omega_m) f(z), f(z) = (1+z)^(3(1+w0+wa)) exp(-3 wa z/(1+z)) for w(z) = w0 + wa z/(1+z) (Eq. 1, l.147); LCDM is w0=-1, wa=0. Radiation is left out (z <= 2.33 for every observable here); control C0.2 measures its effect with Omega_r h^2 = 4.18e-5 (photons plus 3.046 massless neutrinos) at h = 0.6744.
distances: D_C(z) = (c/H0) int_0^z dz'/E(z'); luminosity distance D_L = (1+z_HEL) D_C(z_HD) (the Pantheon+ and DES convention, also Cobaya's); variant (1+z_HD) reported as a control. BAO: D_M = D_C, D_H = c/(H0 E), D_V = (z D_M^2 D_H)^(1/3), each divided by r_d.
sn_magnitudes: Pantheon+: m = m_b_corr (column of Pantheon+SH0ES.dat), covariance Pantheon+SH0ES_STAT+SYS.cov. DES5Y: mu = MU of DES-SN5YR_HD.csv, covariance covsys_000.txt plus MUERR_FINAL^2 on the diagonal (Cobaya sn.desy5 convention); m_DES = MU - 19.33 (Eq. 2, l.240). Model m_th = 5 log10(H0 D_L / c) + M', where M' absorbs H0 and the absolute magnitude; H0 never enters an SN-only result.
cuts: Both samples: 0.02 <= z_HD <= 1.2 (l.257). DES5Y: rows with MUERR_FINAL > 1 removed ('magnitude errors delta m > 1', l.257: read as the catalogue's total diagonal error). Covariances are the sub-matrices of the kept rows. Pantheon+ duplicate entries of one SN are kept, as the paper says (l.259).
offset_parameter: chi2 values are profiled over M' (chi2_prof = r'C^-1 r - (1'C^-1 r)^2/(1'C^-1 1), r = m - m_th at M'=0). Posteriors marginalise M' analytically with a flat prior (the paper's 'M as a derived parameter', l.304-305); the two differ by a constant, so delta chi2 and posterior shapes do not depend on the choice.
planck_reference: 'Planck LCDM' = flat LCDM with Omega_m = 0.3135 (l.259, CamSpec 12.5cln TTTEEE of Efstathiou & Gratton 2021, footnote l.244), taken as printed (reference_value). Its +-0.0081 is used only in sigma statements.
best_fits: Minimise chi2_prof: LCDM over Omega_m in [0.01, 0.99]; w0waCDM over (Omega_m, w0, wa) from the lowest grid point and four other starts (Nelder-Mead, then Powell), unbounded except Omega_m in (0, 1). The minimum inside the printed prior box of the sample is reported beside it when different.
omega_m_with_error: 'best fit gives Omega_m = x +- s' (l.266, 279): reported three ways: best fit; marginal posterior mean and standard deviation (flat prior, Omega_m in [0.01, 0.99]); half-width of the profile interval chi2 < chi2_min + 1. The figure legends (Fig. 1) give best fits.
posteriors: Likelihood exp(-chi2/2) with M' marginalised, on a grid Omega_m 0.01..0.81 step 0.005, w0 -2..1 step 0.02, wa -10..2 step 0.05 (cell centres), times the uniform prior box of the run. 1D and 2D marginals by summing the grid. Credible level of a point in a 2D projection: posterior mass of cells whose marginal density exceeds the density at that point (bilinear interpolation); 'inside the 1 sigma contour' means level <= 0.6827, '2 sigma' 0.9545. No smoothing (the paper used MULTINEST, l.308; its plotting smoothing is unknown).
priors: As printed (l.299-303): Pantheon+ Omega_m [0.2, 0.6], w0 [-1.4, 0.4], wa [-4, -0.4]; DES5Y Omega_m [0.01, 0.81], w0 [-2, 1], wa [-10, 1]. Because the printed Pantheon+ wa range excludes wa = 0, a variant with Pantheon+ wa [-10, 2] (the plotted range of Fig. 2 and beyond) is pre-declared and reported; the claim is judged on both. The H0 prior (l.303) has no effect on SN-only results (l.305-306) and is not used for them.
sigma_statements: Difference of two Gaussian numbers: |x1 - x2| / sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2), and |x1 - x2| / s1 reported too. Delta chi2 between nested fits: p = 1 - CDF_chi2(Delta chi2; k), k = number of extra free parameters (Planck LCDM fixed vs LCDM fit k = 1, vs w0waCDM fit k = 3; LCDM fit vs w0waCDM fit k = 2), and n sigma = sqrt(2) erfinv(1 - p) (two-sided Gaussian equivalent); sqrt(Delta chi2) also reported. 2D credible level l -> n sigma = sqrt(2) erfinv(l).
common_sn: A DES5Y SN is common to Pantheon+ when the same CID (string) appears in Pantheon+ with the same IDSURVEY (primary rule); variant: same CID in any survey (Pantheon+ duplicates averaged). Delta m = m_b_corr(Pantheon+) - (MU(DES5Y) - 19.33). Mean with equal weights (l.391), error = sample standard deviation (ddof 1)/sqrt(N), dispersion = sample standard deviation (ddof 1). z_median: median of DES5Y z_HD (variant: Pantheon+ z_HD). Survey names (Scolnic et al. 2022, SNANA IDSURVEY): 10 DES, 150 FOUND, 5 CSP, 63 CFA3S, 64 CFA3K, 65 CFA4P2, 66 CFA4P3.
lowz_shift: '0.04 mag subtracted from the low redshift sub-samples' (l.414): MU -> MU - 0.04 for every DES5Y row with IDSURVEY != 10 (primary); variant: every row with z_HD < 0.1 (l.563 says 'SN at z < 0.1'). Covariance unchanged.
bao: DESI DR1 BAO, 12 numbers with covariance (Cobaya desi_2024_gaussian_bao_ALL_GCcomb). The observables scale with alpha = c/(H0 r_d) only. Primary (as printed, l.650): Gaussian prior r_d = 147.31 +- 0.31 Mpc and a flat H0 prior on [20, 100], which gives alpha a prior density proportional to alpha^-2 (alpha^-1 per unit ln alpha) on the range H0 in [20, 100] (r_d integrated); variant: also the Planck H0 prior 67.44 +- 0.58 of l.303 (alpha log-normal). alpha marginalised by quadrature (241 nodes in ln alpha). SN offsets marginalised as above; priors on (Omega_m, w0, wa): the DES5Y box for every appendix run.
